encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: αἴρου τὰ μείζω, κεὐθὺ τοῦ καρχησίου
ἄνελκε τὴν γραῦν, τὴν νέαν τ' ἐπουρίσας
πλήρωσον, εὐτρεπῆ τε τὸν κοντὸν ποιοῦ,
καὶ τοὺς κάλως ἔκλυε καὶ χάλα πόδα.

div.note: Athenaeus 11, 782f ἄκατος ποτήριον ἐοικὸς πλοίῳ. Ἐπικράτης κτλ.

1. καὶ add. Iacobs. Add. Ath. 249. 2. κεὐθὺ Dindf.] καὶ εὐθὺ. 3. τ'] δ' Casaub. ἐπουρίσας E] ἐπηυρίσας. 4. εὐτρεπῆ Valcken. Diatr. Eur. 235] ἐντρεπῆ. 5. κάλως Valck.] κάλους. πόδα C et cod. Levin.] πόδας epit. Hoeschel. 1. ἄγε δὴ supplet Iacobs. pro κυλίκια Mein. κυμβία: nam 'requiritur nomen quod et poculum et navigium significet'. de hac voce (κύμβη, κυμβίον) doctissima est disputatio M. Hauptii Opusc. I 231 sq. 4. 'contum compone: solve rudentes et pedem laxa'. Valcken. ridicula ambiguitate vocabula nautica ad res obscaenas significandas adhibuit (Villebr.). κοντός (α κεντεῖν, cf. Κένταυρος) ut πούς membrum virile designat. Schol. Eurip. Med. 679 ἀσκοῦ τὸν προύχοντα πόδα . . . μὴ λύσῃς. ἀσκοῦ οὖν τῆς γαστρός, πόδα
